rule.pit: states_outcome = top-10 title/snippet states the post-cutoff outcome (regex fixed in queries.json); lower is better. Each provider uses its own best native date fence (see 'fence').
rule.blinding: providers relabelled A.. per item in seeded random order before scoring; see blind packet.
